messages.subject: Re: Unable to execute the runApp("") function

If you're already in the App1 directory, then you can just call runApp() or runApp(".").

On Fri, Apr 3, 2015 at 2:48 PM, sanchit shaleen <sanchits...@gmail.com> wrote:
Hi,

With reference to the example http://shiny.rstudio.com/tutorial/lesson1/  , when I copy the code of server.R and ui.R in my own directory named "App1" and then try to 
run the command runApp("App1"), I see the error "Error in shinyAppDir(x) : No Shiny application exists at the path "App-1""  even though the current working directory has been set to the location of "App1".

Please let me know the solution

Thanks
